title: Re-registration of the I14-1 Part B deployment test of g v2 with the Q1 grid swept in serpentine order; I14-1 replica, module, references, checks, thresholds and label unchanged; sky130 77 K, 18 devices
reregisters: I14-1 (failed core check: Q1 runs, 2 gmin-stepping warning lines in 1 of 126 element decks, nmos_L8_W1p6 exchanged tight)

done_before.location: warnings only at the restart of the inner sweep at V(g) = 1.85 V (V(d) +1.85 -> -1.85 V); isolated op at (1.85, -1.85) V and sweeps starting there print none; itl2 100/200/500 and itl1 500 leave the warnings unchanged

compensation.none: sensed current contains forward-biased drain-junction current in the reverse quadrant, up to 0.039 A; forward quadrant equal to I14-1
compensation.junction_only_replica_CCCS: exact to 5.7e-5 of the Q1 tolerance (exchanged bench); forward tight card + replica run aborts on nmos_L8_W1p6 M2 (timestep too small at V(d) = -1.825 V)
compensation.body_current_routing: warnings on nmos_L8_W1p6 M2 forward decks

done_before.conclusion: no tested replica change keeps convergence unchanged on the other devices; replica kept as I14-1

runtime_decomposition_ro5_A_I14_M2.runtime_variant: none registered (largest replica-side reduction without new warnings: ratio 4.7 -> 4.6)

not_done_before: Part B runs on M2 cards other than nmos_L8_W1p6 (precheck, disclosed)

change.procedure: every Q1 grid deck (card, card_rep, elem; forward and exchanged; default, r4, tight; incl. the Q4 default grid): one dc VD per V(g) line (V(g) 0 -> +-1.85 V, 25 mV), V(d) ascending on even lines and descending on odd lines, wrdata appended (set appendwrite), rows put back in nested order by i15_1_serp.grid_rows (rejects missing or duplicated grid values); a grid run with row count != 11175 is a failed run
change.unchanged: grid points, benches, tolerances, replica (I14-1 REPLICA_CHAN + gmin VCCS), module text, references, thresholds, label; AC, dense, measured-curve and circuit decks
change.justification: warnings located at the 3.7 V restart jump of the nested sweep at tight tolerance; the bias point converges when reached from a neighbouring point
change.limitation_reported: a nested sweep with the restart jump at tight tolerance can print gmin-stepping warnings for the element deck (I14-1: 1 of 126 element decks, 1 of 108 card + replica decks)

part_B.cards: M2: refit from direct43_r3_fd with the arm's full-data g frozen in the loop (TRF, max_nfev 400, irls 2, diff_step 0.01, state C)
core: Q3 0 circuits failing only with the element
restrictions: >= 1 gds curve (of 90) with an introduced sign change
part_B.label: any core fail -> not deployable; core pass and >= 1 restriction -> deployable with restrictions; else deployable (simulator-level)
part_B.amendment_A1_of_I12_1: applies (circuit runtime ratio over circuits where M2_card and M2_full pass; no repeats after a failed run)
part_B.reference_arm_v1: same stages with full|M_bias (inputs is_pmos, |V(g,s)|/VDD, |V(d,s)|/VDD; module i14_1_bias_corr_v1); label reported, not the outcome; exchanged-terminal Verilog-A check expected to fail
part_B.m2_cards_reported: max relative parameter difference vs I14-1 M2 cards (expected 0)
part_B.q1_runs_scope: every element deck: grids (serpentine), AC, dense; grid row count != 11175 counts as a failed run

restriction_items_reported: Q1 max relative difference at |I_py| > 1 nA per device, default / r4 / tight
gds curves with an introduced sign change: points with dI/dV(d,s) < 0 for element, card, I_card exp(g); g range
runtime: grid and circuit ratios; ro5_A decomposition (card, card_rep, elem; wall and rusage load time) on I15-1 M2 cards

accuracy.element_deck: reported, no rule: native RRMS of the held-out pairs (v2 and v1), Python and channel-model Python RRMS, differences to the I13-1 rows, all-device / combined / median, GMR(native v2, C0_refit), GMR(native v2, stored v1), GMR(native v2, native v1), GMR(native v1, C0_refit)

validity.V1: card-only library deck (OSDI build, clamp written) x exp(fold g) reproduces the 36 I13-1 rows (v2, v1): max |diff| <= 1e-9
validity.V2: unit tests of I14-1 plus tests.test_i15_1_serp pass
validity.V3: 18 element-deck accuracy rows per arm; 0 failed M2 refits per arm

decision.invalid: any validity fail -> stop: fix and re-register
decision.not deployable: Part B (v2) not deployable -> stop; diagnose the failed core checks
decision.deployable, accuracy below v1 (not non-i: Part B (v2) deployable with restrictions or deployable (simulator-level) -> stop v2; report the accuracy cost of the deployment constraints
decision.note: A1 pass / A2 fail fixed by I13-1; element-deck accuracy and the reference arm do not change the outcome

order: prereg commit (alone) -> code + unit tests commit -> smoke (2 devices, refit max_nfev 20) -> queue: I15_1_validity, I15_1_accuracy, I15_1_deploy_v2, I15_1_deploy_v1, I15_1_restrict, I15_1_decide
